verses.text: Ayik ix ek' jun pekti', ix aj jun scarruaje winhaj Absalón stok'ji yuj nok' chej, ix sayan 50 heb' soldado winh yik stanhwaj winh yuj heb'.

Ak'walto sk'e wa'an winh t'a junjun k'u, tz'aj linhan winh t'a yol b'e sk'och t'a spuerta'il chonhab'. Yalnhej mach sjawi t'a winh rey yik sb'o'an yaj yowal, syamjioch wan heb' yuj winh, sk'anb'an winh t'a heb' tas chonhab'il heb'. Ayik syalan heb' tas chonhab'il heb', mach ay yinhtilal heb',
syalan winh t'a heb' icha tik: Wach'ton tas tzul he b'o tik, smoj ton sb'o yaj t'ayex, palta malaj mach sb'o'an yuj winh rey chi', xchi winh t'a heb'.
Syalanpax winh icha tik: Ok in wal tzin ak'jioch juezal t'a jun chonhab' tik, ayik tzex jawi t'ayin he b'o yaj eyowal, elanhchamel am tzin b'o t'ayex, xchi winh t'a heb'.
Ay junxo tas syutej heb' anima chi' winh, ayik wanto sk'och heb' t'a winh, ayik manto em nhojan heb' t'a yichanh winh, tz'och lak'naj winh t'a heb', stz'ub'anelta sti' heb' winh.
Ichanhej chi' ix yutej masanil heb' yetisraelal winh sk'och t'a winh rey yik sb'o yaj yowal. Icha chi' ix aj smontaj heb' anima chi' yuj winh.

Chanhe' ab'il ix sk'ulej winh icha chi', ix lajwi chi', ix yalan winh t'a winh rey chi' icha tik: --Mamin rey, tzin k'an t'ayach to tzin a chab'at t'a Hebrón, yik wach' tzin k'anab'ajej in ti' wak'nak t'a Jehová.
Ayik ayinto ek' t'a Gesur t'a yol yik Siria, wak'nak in ti' t'a Jehová, walannak t'ay, tato tz'el t'a sk'o'ol to tzin meltzaj t'a Jerusalén, yowalil ol wak' junok in silab' t'ay, xchi winh.
--Ixik t'a junk'olal, xchi winhaj rey David chi'. Yuj chi' ix b'at winh t'a Hebrón chi'.

Ayik ix k'och winh ta', ix yak'anb'at schekab' winh t'a elk'altak t'a junjun yinhtilal heb' israel yik tz'alji t'a heb' to ayik ol yab'an heb' yok' nok' ch'a'ak, syalan heb' to toxo ix och winhaj Absalón reyal t'a Hebrón.
Chab' ciento heb' winh aj Jerusalén ix yik'b'at winh yet'ok. Ha heb' chi' malaj jab'ok tas yojtak heb' tas wan sna'an winh.

Ayik wan yak'an silab' chi' winh, ix schekan winh b'at ik'jokkot winhaj Ahitofel t'a schonhab', haton Gilo. Ak'um razón yaj winh t'a winhaj David. Ha jun tas ix sna winhaj Absalón chi' wan yoch yip yujto ix k'ib' sb'isul heb' anima ix och yet' winh.
Ay jun chekab' ix jawi yal t'a winh rey chi', ix yalan icha tik: Niwanxo heb' ketisraelal ayxo och yet' winhaj Absalón, xchi.

Yuj chi', ix yal winh rey chi' t'a masanil heb' yajal yaj yet' winh t'a Jerusalén chi': --Koyek, konh elek t'a winhaj Absalón chi'. Tato ma'ay, manhxo ol yal-laj ko kolan ko b'a t'a winh. Ko pilek kip yik manhxo ol onh yamchaj yuj winh yik tzonh smilancham yet' masanil anima t'a yol chonhab' tik, xchi winh rey chi'.
Ix tak'wi heb' t'a winh: --Mamin rey, ol ko k'anab'ajej tas tzala', xchi heb'.

Icha chi' ix aj yel winhaj rey David chi' t'a sti' chonhab', heb' ix yetb'eyum winh, heb' yuninal winh yet' pax heb' yetyajalil winh. Haxonhej lajunhwanh heb' ix schab'il yetb'eyum winh ix kan stanhwej spat.
Ayik toxo ix el winh yet' masanil heb' anima chi', ix och wa'an heb' t'a stielxo chonhab'.

Masanil heb' yetyajalil winh, ix k'och heb' t'a stz'ey winh. Haxo pax heb' soldado stanhwan winh, haton heb' cereteo yet' heb' peleteo, t'a stzolal ix b'at heb' t'a yichanh winh yet' wake' ciento heb' soldado kotnak yet' winh t'a Gat.
Ix yalan winhaj rey David chi' t'a winhaj Itai aj chonhab' Gat: --¿Tas yuj ipan ach tzach b'at ket'ok? Meltzajanh, wach' tzach kan yet' junxo winh rey ol och chi', yujto ch'ok chonhab'il ach.

Toto janak ach, max yal-laj ach wak'an pural a b'at ket'ok, yujto a in tik manh wojtakok b'ajtil ol in k'ochok. Wach' tzach meltzaji, ik'b'at heb' winh etchonhab' tik het'ok. Yak'okab' swach'k'olal Jehová t'a eyib'anh t'a masanil tiempo, xchi winh rey chi'.

Ix tak'wi winhaj Itai chi': --Mamin rey, swak' in ti' t'a yichanh Dios yet' t'a ichanh, yalnhej b'aj ol ach k'ochok, taxonhej tzonh chami, mato wach' tzonh aji, ol in b'atnhej het'ok a in a chekab' in tik, xchi winh.
--Ichokab'ta', koyek, b'ab'lajanhek, xchi winhaj David chi'. Yuj chi' ix b'atnhej winhaj Itai chi' yet' heb' ajun yet' winh rey chi'. Ajun heb' yuninal winh rey chi' yet' heb' ix yetb'eyum winh.
Masanil anima, ayik ix yilan heb' sb'at winh rey chi' yet' heb' soldado, ix te ok' heb' sik'lab'il. Ix ek' heb' anima wan yel chi' t'a yol ha' Cedrón, ix b'at heb' t'a sb'e'al lum lum kuseltakxo.

Ajun pax winhaj Sadoc yet' winhaj Abiatar yet' heb' levita. Yet'nak te' skaxa'il strato Dios heb'. Ix yak'an em te' kaxa chi' heb' masanto ix yal slajwib'at heb' anima ix b'at yet' winh rey chi' t'a yol chonhab' chi'.
Ix yalan winh rey t'a winhaj Sadoc chi' icha tik: --Ik'ekxioch te' kaxa t'a yol chonhab' tik. Tato ol och Jehová wet'ok, ol in meltzajxok, ol wilanxioch te' yet' skajnub' Jehová.
Tato maxtzak tzalaj wet' jun, ujokab' icha wal tas snib'ej t'ayin, xchi winhaj David chi'.

Ix yalanxi winh rey chi' t'a winhaj sacerdote Sadoc chi': --Ach schekab' Dios, meltzajanh t'a junk'olal yet' winhaj Abiatar yet' chawanh heb' eyuninal tik, winhaj Ahimaas, winh iko' yet' winhaj Jonatán winh yik winhaj Abiatar.
Ha inxo tik, ol in kan t'a spanhanil lum b'aj te kuseltakxo tik, masanto ol ja spekal t'ayin eyu'uj, xchi winh rey chi'.
Ixlajwi chi', ix meltzaj winhaj sacerdote Sadoc yet' winhaj Abiatar t'a chonhab' Jerusalén chi', yet'nak te' skaxa'il strato Jehová heb' winh, ix k'ochxikan heb' winh ta'.

Ix k'e winhaj David chi' yet' heb' ajun yet' winh t'a lum tzalan Olivo, wan yok' winh sik'lab'il, malaj xanhab' winh ayochi, pichb'il sjolom winh yuj kusk'olal. Icha ix yutej sb'a winh rey chi', icha chi' ix yutejpax sb'a heb' ajun yet' winh chi'.
Ix alji t'a winh rey chi' to a winhaj Ahitofel ayxo och winh yet' winhaj Absalón, yuj chi' ix sk'an winh t'a Jehová yik max elk'och tas nab'il yuj winhaj Ahitofel chi'.

Ayik ix k'ek'och winh rey chi' t'a tzalan Olivo, b'aj tz'och ejmelal t'a Dios, ix jawi jun winh yamigo winh, haton winhaj Husai yinhtilal arquita. Ix jawi winh scha winh rey chi', nhik'chimtakxonhej spichul winh, ayk'e lum pokok t'a sjolom winh.
Ix yalan winh rey chi' t'a winh icha tik: --Tato tzach b'at wet'ok, tonhej tzin kan t'a spatik u'uj.

Palta te wach' tato tzach meltzaj t'a Jerusalén tzalan t'a winhaj Absalón icha tik: Mamin rey, a in tik tzin kan a chekab'ok icha ix aj woch schekab'ok winh a mam, tato xa chi. Icha chi' ol aj och wet'ok yik max elk'och tas nab'il yuj winhaj Ahitofel chi'.
Hata' ix kan winhaj sacerdote Sadoc yet' winhaj Abiatar chi'. Masanil tas ol ab' yalji t'a yol palacio chi', elanhchamel tzalb'at yab' heb' winh.

Hata' ay pax winhaj Ahimaas yet' winhaj Jonatán yuninal heb' winh chawanh chi'. Masanil tas tzab'i, ha t'a heb' winh tzalb'ati, haxo heb' winh ol alankot t'ayin, xchi winh rey chi' t'a winhaj Husai chi'.
Yuj chi' ix meltzaj winhaj Husai t'a Jerusalén chi'. Ayik ix k'och winh, wan wal yoch winhaj Absalón t'a yol chonhab' chi'.
